subject: Sable discovery follow-up & next steps: stakeholder map, NDA -> MSA sequencing
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Rao <priya.rao@sablelogistics.com>, Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@sablelogistics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Sable discovery follow-up & next steps: stakeholder map, NDA -> MSA sequencing

Hi Priyanka / Alex —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed sequencing so we keep momentum: 

1) Economic buyer & decision criteria
- Priyanka: you confirmed total cost of ownership, latency for last-mile route planning, and data residency are the top three decision knobs.
- Next ask: can you confirm the final sign-off owner for budget (title/email)? We have this tentatively as Alex (Head of R&D).

2) Security & procurement route
- Procurement will require an executed NDA before we share a short SOC2 package and load a sandbox with real telemetry samples. You indicated procurement@sablelogistics.com handles initial contracts.

3) Contract sequencing and owners (recommended)
- Step A: Mutual NDA (fast path, DocuSign) — attach Sable_NDA_v1.pdf for draft. Target turn time: 3 business days for initial signature.
- Step B: Pilot statement + DPA addendum included with MSA — sequence MSA after NDA redline sprint. Target MSA redline turnaround: 7–10 business days.
- Step C: Production MSA + commitment. Joel from our legal ops will handle the DocuSign package once Ben routes the redline.

4) Action items / owners (who does what)
- Priyanka: confirm budget sign-off owner and procurement contact (by EOD Thu 4/29).
- Procurement: please review attached NDA draft and indicate any required procurement clauses (payables, PO flow).
- Ben Carter (legal liaison): will own our side of the redline and coordinate fast-track for NDA + MSA.
- Rishi Malhotra (solutions): will prepare a concise pilot plan (3–4 week scope) and sandbox access checklist once NDA is signed.

Attachments: Sable_NDA_v1.pdf (attached), Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (we'll drop full SOC2 once NDA executed).

If that sequencing looks right, I'll send the DocuSign NDA and loop Ben for legal redline expectations.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0189
https://www.redwood.ai
From: Priyanka Rao <priya.rao@sablelogistics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@sablelogistics.com>
Cc: procurement@sablelogistics.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sable discovery follow-up & next steps: stakeholder map, NDA -> MSA sequencing

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear recap. Agree with sequencing and owners. A few clarifications from our side:

- Budget sign-off: Alex (alex.nguyen@sablelogistics.com) is final for tech spend > $250k; I will own the commercial approval for the pilot.
- Procurement contact: procurement@sablelogistics.com (cc'd) — they will validate the NDA and confirm whether we need PO terms included.
- Security ask: before we sign, procurement will want to see a SOC2 summary and our data flow diagram (we can accept summary under NDA).

A couple of constraints:
- Procurement legal requires a 2-person review for any external MSA redlines and typically asks for consolidated comments (we'll try to turn MSA redlines in 5–7 business days once NDA is in place).
- For the pilot we prefer hashed telemetry only in the sandbox until DPA is agreed. Will that be acceptable to Redwood?

We can sign the NDA quickly. Please send the DocuSign link.

Priyanka Rao
Senior Product Manager, Data & Insights
Sable Logistics
priya.rao@sablelogistics.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sable discovery follow-up & next steps: stakeholder map, NDA -> MSA sequencing

Thanks Evelyn / Priyanka — leaving a note on internal sequencing and our SLA for turnaround so expectations are explicit.

Internal plan (Redwood legal ops):
- I will review Sable_NDA_v1.pdf and return an edit-locked DocuSign-ready draft within 24 business hours. If procurement wants custom PO terms, we'll surface those as an exhibit to the MSA (avoid gating the NDA).
- Target NDA turnaround: 1–3 business days (we'll aim for same-day edits if comments are minor).
- Target MSA redline window: 7–10 business days depending on complexity; if Sable consolidates comments we'll fast-track to 5 business days.

Rishi: once NDA is signed, please prepare the pilot SOC2 summary packet (redacted) and the sandbox ingestion checklist — include recommended hashing approach for telemetry. Keep the pilot scope minimal: 4 routes, 2M daily events, 3-week run.

Marissa: loop LegalOps incase procurement requests a security addendum (DPA). Also, let's pull the standard DPA template and prepare it to be attached as an exhibit.

I'll own correspondence with procurement and will be the single point person for legal redlines. Evelyn — once Priyanka confirms DocuSign, I'll start the edit pass.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Sable discovery follow-up & next steps: stakeholder map, NDA -> MSA sequencing

Hi Priyanka —

Great — thanks. I’m sending the NDA now via DocuSign (link below). Ben will be on the thread for the redline and Marissa will prep the DPA exhibit concurrently so we don't lose time.

DocuSign NDA: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=00000000&PowerFormId=abcd-1234

Next steps recap (concrete):
- Priyanka: sign NDA via DocuSign (target: today / tomorrow).
- Procurement: confirm any mandatory procurement clauses you need added to NDA or indicate that you prefer items moved to the MSA exhibit.
- Ben: review redlines and coordinate consolidated comments.
- Rishi: standing by to send SOC2 summary and sandbox checklist once NDA is executed (we will only provide hashed telemetry for pilot, per Sable's preference).

If all agreed, I will schedule a 30-minute pilot kickoff for Mon 5/3 — propose 10am PT — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks everyone —
Evelyn
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0189
